issues.description: The problem statement and UML require a Lecture constructor that initializes all five attributes (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors). The template provides a constructor with only three parameters (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents), which conflicts with the specified design and the solution. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected constructor signature and parameter order, and may lead to incorrect implementations or frustration when tests expect the five-parameter constructor.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the constructor in the template to match the UML and the solution: provide a constructor with five parameters in the specified order (String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) and leave the body with a TODO or minimal assignments. This makes the template signature consistent with the problem description and the reference solution while still requiring students to implement the constructor body.
